```{r}
# =========================================================================
# 1. Calculate Raw Summary Statistics (Mean, SE, SD, Median)
# =========================================================================
raw_stats <- df_modeling %>%
  group_by(Site, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    raw_mean   = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    raw_median = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd         = sd(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    se         = sd / sqrt(n),
    # Error bars for SE
    lower_se   = raw_mean - se,
    upper_se   = raw_mean + se,
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

# Make sure site is a factor matching your layout
raw_stats$Site   <- factor(raw_stats$Site)
df_modeling$Site <- factor(df_modeling$Site)

# =========================================================================
# 2. Plot Raw Means + SE + Raw Points
# =========================================================================
p_raw_summary <- ggplot() +
  # --- Background Raw Individual Data Points ---
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_modeling,
    aes(x = Site, y = slope, color = Species, shape=K_3),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.55),
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 2.0
  ) +
  
  # --- Raw Means (Large Solid Points) ---
  geom_point(
    data = raw_stats,
    aes(x = Site, y = raw_mean, color = Species),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.55),
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  
  # --- Raw Standard Error Bars ---
  geom_errorbar(
    data = raw_stats,
    aes(x = Site, ymin = lower_se, ymax = upper_se, color = Species),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.55),
    width = 0.20,
    linewidth = 0.85
  ) +
  
  # --- Aesthetics & Formatting ---
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors, name = "species") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Raw Data Summaries: Mean ± SE",
    subtitle = "Summary statistics calculated directly from observed slope values",
    x        = "Site",
    y        = "ED50"
  )

print(p_raw_summary)
```

```{r}
#models

k3_model <-lmer(slope ~ K_3 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k4_model <-lmer(slope ~ K_4 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k3ms <- lmer(slope ~ Species + K_3 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k4ms <- lmer(slope ~ Species + K_4 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k3msi <- lmer(slope ~ Species * K_3 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k4msi <- lmer(slope ~ Species * K_4 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k3_spp_random <- lmer(slope ~ K_3 + (1 | Site) + (1 | Species), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k4_spp_random <- lmer(slope ~ K_4 + (1 | Site) + (1 | Species), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
```

```{r}
plot_data <- master_model_table %>%
  rename(R2_target = Conditional_R2)

# 2. Compute the Efficiency (Pareto) Frontier
# Sort by BIC ascending, then calculate cumulative max R2
frontier_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(BIC, desc(R2_target)) %>%
  mutate(cum_max_R2 = cummax(R2_target)) %>%
  filter(R2_target == cum_max_R2) %>%
  distinct(R2_target, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 3. Tag models in main table as Efficient vs. Suboptimal
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(is_frontier = Model_Name %in% frontier_data$Model_Name)

# 4. Generate Efficiency Frontier Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = BIC, y = R2_target)) +
  # Draw step line for efficiency frontier
  # geom_step(
  #   data = frontier_data,
  #   aes(x = BIC, y = R2_target),
  #   direction = "hv",
  #   color = "#1f77b4",
  #   linewidth = 1,
  #   linetype = "dashed"
  # ) +
  # Points for suboptimal models
  geom_point(
    data = filter(plot_data, !is_frontier),
    color = "gray60",
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  # Highlight points on the efficiency frontier
  geom_point(
    data = filter(plot_data, is_frontier),
    color = "#1f77b4",
    size = 4
  ) +
  # Model Labels (non-overlapping)
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Model_Name, color = is_frontier),
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = ifelse(plot_data$is_frontier, "bold", "plain"),
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#1f77b4", "FALSE" = "gray30")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Efficiency Frontier (BIC vs. Conditional R²)",
    #subtitle = "Dashed line marks Pareto-optimal models (higher R² for a given BIC penalty)",
    x = "BIC ",
    y = expression("Conditional " * R^2 * "")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
all_models <- list(
  spp_m    = spp_m,
  k3_model = k3_model,
  k4_model = k4_model,
  k3ms     = k3ms,
  k4ms     = k4ms,
  k3msi    = k3msi,
  k4msi    = k4msi,
  k3_spp_random = k3_spp_random,
  k4_spp_random = k4_spp_random
)

# 2. Extract AIC, BIC, and both R2 values together
master_model_table <- imap_dfr(all_models, function(model_obj, model_name) {
  
  # Grab information criteria
 perf <- model_performance(model_obj, estimator = "ML")
  
  # Grab variance partition metrics
  r2_vals <- r2(model_obj)
  
  data.frame(
    Model_Name      = model_name,
    AIC             = round(perf$AIC, 1),
    BIC             = round(perf$BIC, 1),
    Marginal_R2     = round(r2_vals$R2_marginal, 3),
    Conditional_R2  = round(r2_vals$R2_conditional, 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

# 3. View the table sorted by AIC to look at the trade-offs cleanly
print(master_model_table %>% arrange(AIC))
#spp pnly is best, then k3msi

k3_emmeans_obj <- emmeans(all_models$k3ms, pairwise ~ K_3, adjust = "tukey")
k3_emm_df <- as.data.frame(k3_emmeans_obj$emmeans)
k3_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(k3_emmeans_obj$contrasts)

cat("--- Estimated Marginal Means (ED50) for K_3 Clusters ---\n")
print(k3_emm_df %>% dplyr::select(K_3, emmean, SE, df, lower.CL, upper.CL))

cat("\n--- Pairwise Tukey Contrasts Between K_3 Clusters ---\n")
print(k3_contrasts_df %>% dplyr::select(contrast, estimate, SE, p.value))

#BEST MODEL k3ms 
# --- 1. Model Checks & ANOVA ---
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(resid(k3ms) ~ fitted(k3ms), main = "Residuals vs Fitted (k3ms)", xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Residuals")
qqnorm(resid(k3ms), main = "Normal Q-Q Plot (k3ms)")
qqline(resid(k3ms), col = "red")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 

#Test overall significance of single model
anova(k3ms)  #spp is sig here

# --- 2. Extract EMMs &  Letter Display ---
k3ms_cluster_emm <- emmeans(k3ms, specs = ~ K_3) 

# Convert EMM to dataframe and compute CLD letters
cld_clusters <- cld(k3ms_cluster_emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    K_3 = as.factor(K_3),
    .group = trimws(.group)
  )

#factor level

cluster_levels <- c("ICRA", "Acropora_1", "Acropora_2")
df_modeling <- df_modeling %>%
  mutate(
    K_3_str = as.character(K_3),
    K_3_labeled = case_match(
      K_3_str,
      "2" ~ "ICRA",
      "1" ~ "Acropora_1",
      "3" ~ "Acropora_2",
      .default = K_3_str
    ),
    K_3_labeled = factor(K_3_labeled, levels = cluster_levels)
  )

#align cld_clusters identically
cld_clusters <- cld_clusters %>%
  mutate(
    K_3_str = as.character(K_3),
    K_3_labeled = case_match(
      K_3_str,
      "2" ~ "ICRA",
      "1" ~ "Acropora_1",
      "3" ~ "Acropora_2",
      .default = K_3_str
    ),
    K_3_labeled = factor(K_3_labeled, levels = cluster_levels)
  )

# 4. Generate Plot (both layers now use identical K_3_labeled factors)
plot_k3ms <- ggplot() +
  # Layer A: Raw jittered points
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_modeling, 
    aes(x = K_3_labeled, y = slope, color = Species, fill = Species, shape = Site),
    width = 0.18, 
    alpha = 0.55, 
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  # Layer B: Model Estimated Marginal Means (Black points + Error bars)
  geom_errorbar(

  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cld_clusters,
    aes(x = K_3_labeled, y = emmean),
    size = 4, 
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Layer C: Statistical significance letters (CLD)
  geom_text(
    data = cld_clusters,
    aes(x = K_3_labeled, y = upper.CL + 0.15, label = .group),

    size = 5.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Styling & Labels

  theme(
   axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Photophysiological Cluster",
    y = expression(Estimated~Marginal~Mean~slope~"("*degree*C*")"),
    color = "Species",
    fill  = "Species",
    shape = "Site"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors, limits = species_order) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors, limits = species_order) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = custom_shapes)

print(plot_k3ms)
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(patchwork)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Setup Data for the Winning k3ms Model
# ==============================================================================
Ychoice <- "slope" # Set to "ED50" or your color slope variable name

cb_clean <- df_modeling %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[Ychoice]]), !is.na(Species), !is.na(Site), !is.na(K_3)) %>%
  mutate(
    YY      = .data[[Ychoice]],
    Species = droplevels(as.factor(Species)),
    Site    = droplevels(as.factor(Site)),
    K_3     = droplevels(as.factor(K_3)),
    # Create the Species x Cluster identifier for plotting
    HH      = droplevels(as.factor(paste0(Species, "_", K_3)))
  )

# Filter low-sample HH groups if necessary (purgelimit = 6)
purgelimit <- 5
hh_counts  <- table(cb_clean$HH)
valid_hh   <- names(hh_counts[hh_counts >= purgelimit])

cb_plot <- cb_clean %>% 
  filter(HH %in% valid_hh) %>% 
  mutate(
    Species = droplevels(Species),
    K_3     = droplevels(K_3),
    HH      = droplevels(HH)
  )

# Calculate sample sizes and median outcome per HH combination for ordering
hh_summary <- cb_plot %>% 
  group_by(HH) %>% 
  summarize(N = n(), mnYY = median(YY, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(mnYY))

cb_plot$HH    <- factor(cb_plot$HH, levels = hh_summary$HH)
hh_summary$HH <- factor(hh_summary$HH, levels = hh_summary$HH)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Fit Winning Model (k3ms) & Extract EMMs for Species x K_3 Combinations
# ==============================================================================
# Fit your exact winning model: YY ~ Species + K_3 + (1|Site)
k3ms_plot_model <- lmer(YY ~ Species + K_3 + (1|Site), data = cb_plot, REML = FALSE)

# Extract Estimated Marginal Means for the combined Species x K_3 grid
emm_hh <- emmeans(k3ms_plot_model, ~ Species : K_3)

# Filter out non-existent/empty species-cluster grid cells
emm_hh_df <- as.data.frame(emm_hh) %>%
  mutate(HH = paste0(Species, "_", K_3)) %>%
  filter(HH %in% levels(cb_plot$HH)) %>%
  mutate(HH = factor(HH, levels = hh_summary$HH))

# Pairwise Tukey contrasts across combinations
pairs_hh  <- pairs(emm_hh, adjust = "tukey")
pairs_sum <- summary(pairs_hh)

# Generate Compact Letter Display (CLD) safely
pvals <- pairs_sum$p.value
pvals[is.na(pvals)] <- 1 # Safeguard against missing contrast cells
names(pvals) <- gsub(" - ", "-", pairs_sum$contrast)

# Clean string names to match factor levels
names(pvals) <- gsub("Species|K_3| ", "", names(pvals))

letters_out <- multcompLetters(pvals)$Letters
emm_hh_df$group <- letters_out[match(as.character(emm_hh_df$HH), names(letters_out))]

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Plot 1: ED50 across Species x K3 Cluster (HH)
# ==============================================================================
y_min <- min(cb_plot$YY, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5
y_max <- max(cb_plot$YY, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5

Hplot <- ggplot(cb_plot, aes(x = HH, y = YY)) +
  # Raw data points colored by Species and shaped by Site
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Species, shape = factor(Site)), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  # Model EMMs & SE error bars from k3ms
  geom_point(aes(x = HH, y = emmean), data = emm_hh_df, size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = HH, y = emmean, ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), 
                data = emm_hh_df, width = 0.2, color = "black") +
  # Sample sizes at bottom
  geom_text(aes(x = HH, y = y_min, label = paste0("n=", N)), data = hh_summary, size = 3) +
  # Significance letters at top
  geom_text(aes(x = HH, y = y_max, label = group), data = emm_hh_df, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = 1:8) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(Ychoice, " across Species x K3 Clusters (Model: k3ms)"),
    x = "Species_Cluster (HH)",
    y = expression(ED[50] ~ " (" * degree * C * ")"),
    shape = "Site",
    color = "Species"
  )

print(Hplot)
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Define Explicit Ordering Vector & Data Prep
# ==============================================================================
KK_order <- c("ICRA_2", "AGLO_1", "AGLO_3", "AABR_1", "AABR_3", "AHYA_1")
KK_names <- c(
  "ICRA_2" = "ICRA", 
  "AGLO_1" = "AGLO_1", 
  "AGLO_3" = "AGLO_2", 
  "AABR_1" = "AABR_1", 
  "AABR_3" = "AABR_2", 
  "AHYA_1" = "AHYA_1")

species_labels <- c(
  "AGLO" = "A. globiceps",
  "AABR" = "A. abrotanoides",
  "AHYA" = "A. hyacinthus",
  "ICRA" = "I. crateriformis"
)

df_hh <- df_modeling %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope), !is.na(Species), !is.na(Site), !is.na(K_3)) %>%
  mutate(
    HH = paste0(Species, "_", K_3),
    HH = factor(HH, levels = KK_order),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HH)) # Keep only the 6 target combinations

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Fit Model & Robustly Extract EMMs with Compact Letters
# ==============================================================================
# Fit model with HH as fixed factor
m_hh <- lmer(slope ~ HH + (1|Site), data = df_hh, REML = FALSE)

# Compute EMMs directly for HH
emm_hh_obj <- emmeans(m_hh, ~ HH)

# Generate Compact Letter Display
cld_raw <- as.data.frame(multcomp::cld(emm_hh_obj, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters))

# Dynamically find the lower and upper confidence limit columns
lcl_col <- names(cld_raw)[grep("LCL|lower.CL", names(cld_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
ucl_col <- names(cld_raw)[grep("UCL|upper.CL", names(cld_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]

cld_hh <- cld_raw %>%
  mutate(
    HH      = factor(HH, levels = KK_order),
    ymin    = .data[[lcl_col]],
    ymax    = .data[[ucl_col]],
    .group  = trimws(.group),
    Species = factor(sub("_.*", "", HH), levels = species_order)
  )

# Sample size summary
hh_summary <- df_hh %>%
  group_by(HH) %>%
  summarize(N = n(), .groups = "drop")

KK_raw_order <- c("ICRA_2", "AGLO_1", "AGLO_3", "AABR_1", "AABR_3", "AHYA_1")

# Lookup vector for plot labels
KK_names <- c(
  "ICRA_2" = "ICRA", 
  "AGLO_1" = "AGLO_1", 
  "AGLO_3" = "AGLO_2", 
  "AABR_1" = "AABR_1", 
  "AABR_3" = "AABR_2", 
  "AHYA_1" = "AHYA_1"
)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Plot 1: Raw Data + EMMs + Significance Letters
# ==============================================================================
y_min <- min(df_hh$slope, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.4
y_max <- max(cld_hh$ymax, max(df_hh$slope, na.rm = TRUE)) + 0.4

plot_hh_raw <- ggplot() +
  # Raw jittered points
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_hh,
    aes(x = HH, y = slope, color = Species, fill = Species, shape = Site),
    width = 0.18,
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 2.8
  ) +
  # EMM points + Error bars (using standardized ymin and ymax)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = cld_hh,
    aes(x = HH, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    width = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cld_hh,
    aes(x = HH, y = emmean),
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Sample sizes
  geom_text(
    data = hh_summary,
    aes(x = HH, y = y_min, label = paste0("n=", N)),
    size = 3.5,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  # Significance letters
  geom_text(
    data = cld_hh,
    aes(x = HH, y = ymax + 0.25, label = .group),
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5.0,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Species_Cluster (HH)",
    y = expression(Estimated~Marginal~Mean~slope~"("*degree*C*")"),
    color = "Species",
    fill  = "Species",
    shape = "Site"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors, limits = species_order) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors, limits = species_order) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = custom_shapes) +
  #scale_x_discrete(limits = KK_order, labels  = KK_names)
scale_x_discrete(
    limits = KK_raw_order, # Raw level order in df
    labels = KK_names      # New clean display names on plot
  )
print(plot_hh_raw)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Define explicit display order
KK_order <- c("ICRA", "AGLO_1", "AGLO_2", "AABR_1", "AABR_2", "AHYA_1")

# 2. Recode HH and calculate summary stats (Raw Mean and SE)
df_hh_plot <- df_modeling %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope), !is.na(Species), !is.na(Site), !is.na(K_3)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Recode raw HH levels to clean display labels
    HH_raw = paste0(Species, "_", K_3),
    HH = case_match(
      HH_raw,
      "ICRA_2" ~ "ICRA",
      "AGLO_1" ~ "AGLO_1",
      "AGLO_3" ~ "AGLO_2",
      "AABR_1" ~ "AABR_1",
      "AABR_3" ~ "AABR_2",
      "AHYA_1" ~ "AHYA_1",
      .default = HH_raw
    ),
    HH = factor(HH, levels = KK_order),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HH))

# Descriptive summary table (Observed Mean & SE per HH group)
hh_summary <- df_hh_plot %>%
  group_by(HH, Species) %>%
  summarize(
    N      = n(),
    mean_Y = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_Y   = sd(slope, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Plot Raw Data + Observed Group Means
y_min <- min(df_hh_plot$slope, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.4

plot_hh_raw_only <- ggplot() +
  # Layer 1: Raw individual data points (color + fill mapped to Species)
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_hh_plot,
    aes(x = HH, y = slope, color = Species, fill = Species, shape = Site),
    width = 0.18,
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 2.8
  ) +
  # Layer 2: Observed Group Mean + SE (Black crossbars)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = hh_summary,
    aes(x = HH, ymin = mean_Y - se_Y, ymax = mean_Y + se_Y),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = hh_summary,
    aes(x = HH, y = mean_Y),
    size = 3.8,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "black",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Layer 3: Sample size annotations (n = ...)
  geom_text(
    data = hh_summary,
    aes(x = HH, y = y_min, label = paste0("n=", N)),
    size = 3.5,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  # Formatting & Scales
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression(Raw ~"("*ED[50]*")"~across~Species-Cluster~Combinations),
    x = "Species_Cluster",
    y = "slope",
    color = "Species",
    fill  = "Species",
    shape = "Site"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors, limits = species_order) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors, limits = species_order) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = custom_shapes) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = KK_order)

print(plot_hh_raw_only)
```
